items.name: RUMIN Illustrative Sample Network
items.description: A small, curated network used to demonstrate RUMIN's data model and financial network visualisation. It connects fictional companies to real-world industry classifications, countries and economic-variable definitions through illustrative relationships.
items.provenance_note: Countries (ISO 3166-1 / ISO 4217 codes), industry classifications (ISIC Rev. 4) and the definitions of economic variables refer to real-world concepts; each carries a reference to its authoritative publisher. All companies are fictional. All relationships, polarities and strengths are illustrative modelling assumptions written for demonstration: they are not empirical findings and have not been validated. The dataset contains no observed financial values, prices or time series.
items.license: Authored for the RUMIN project. Contains no third-party data values.

items.name: World Development Indicators
items.description: The World Bank's primary collection of development indicators, compiled from officially recognised international sources. RUMIN retrieves a small, curated selection of annual series for India, with the United States and the United Arab Emirates for context.
items.provenance_note: Retrieved by RUMIN from the World Bank Indicators API (v2) and stored exactly as published: values are not adjusted, converted, rounded or filled in. Each value records when it was retrieved and from which response, and every revision the World Bank makes is kept.
items.attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators. The original source of each series is named on the series.
items.update_frequency: Refreshed by the World Bank several times a year; any value may be revised in an update.
